content.value_statement: Newsletter operators need clear revenue models before selling paid tiers or sponsorships. This skill turns audience metrics into labeled assumptions, rate cards, and growth projections.
actual_capabilities: Builds paid subscription tier models with price, conversion, MRR, and ARR assumptions.
Creates sponsorship inventory and rate cards using CPM, CPC, or flat pricing.
Projects revenue at list growth milestones using referral, recommendation, or boost assumptions.
Labels each input as measured, user provided, estimated, or needing a source.
Checks sponsorship disclosure, offer claim support, and consent gaps before handoff.
limitations: Does not compute final email quality scores or enforce SEND vetoes.
Does not run ROI, payback, or list value calculations.
Needs user supplied audience metrics or exports for measured projections.
Does not include built-in benchmark tables for missing conversion rates or CPMs.

use_cases.title: Price a paid newsletter tier
use_cases.description: Model free-to-paid conversion, monthly price, MRR, ARR, and assumptions for a new paid tier.

use_cases.title: Create a sponsor rate card
use_cases.description: Turn active audience metrics, send cadence, and placements into CPM, CPC, or flat sponsor pricing.

use_cases.title: Plan growth-linked revenue
use_cases.description: Estimate how referral, recommendation, or boost loops change revenue at list growth milestones.

prompt_templates.title: Start a basic model
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan monetization for my newsletter. I have [active subscribers], [open rate], [click rate], and I want [paid subscriptions, sponsorships, or both].

prompt_templates.title: Build a rate card
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a sponsorship rate card for a newsletter with [active subscribers], [open rate], [send cadence], and [available placements].

prompt_templates.title: Compare revenue mixes
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare paid subscription only, sponsorship only, and hybrid models for my list. Use [price points], [conversion assumptions], and [fill rate].

prompt_templates.title: Prepare a full handoff
prompt_templates.prompt: Build the full monetization plan, flag disclosure and claim risks, label all assumptions, and prepare a handoff for ROI and email quality review.

output_examples.input: A 20,000 subscriber newsletter wants paid tiers and sponsors.
output: Recommended hybrid model with a monthly paid tier and two sponsorship placements.
Rate card uses open-based CPM with a floor price and fill-rate assumption.
Projection shows current, 25 percent growth, and 50 percent growth scenarios.

output_examples.input: A creator has sponsor demand but no conversion benchmark.
output: Paid conversion and sponsor fill rate are marked as needing a source.
The model leaves unsupported revenue lines blank instead of inventing figures.
Open loops list the missing metrics required for a defensible plan.

output_examples.input: A media team needs sponsor disclosure and claim review.
output: Every sponsor placement is labeled as an advertisement.
Unsupported price, discount, and performance claims are flagged for registry review.
Consent gaps are listed before the sellable audience is finalized.

best_practices: Provide active subscribers, open rate, click rate, cadence, and current revenue before asking for projections.
Separate measured data from estimates so revenue claims remain clear.
Review disclosures, consent, and claim evidence before using the plan in sales materials.
anti_patterns: Treating estimated conversion rates as measured revenue.
Selling sponsor placements without clear ad disclosure.
Using subscriber counts without checking active status or commercial mail consent.

faq.question: Can I use this with Claude or Codex?
faq.answer: Yes. It supports Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through compatible skill hosts.

faq.question: Does it connect to my email platform?
faq.answer: It is designed for user supplied exports and metrics. Keyed integrations are optional conveniences, not requirements.

faq.question: Does it calculate ROI?
faq.answer: No. It prepares revenue inputs and hands ROI, payback, and list value math to a dedicated calculator.

faq.question: Can it create a sponsorship rate card?
faq.answer: Yes. It can size inventory and suggest CPM, CPC, or flat pricing based on provided audience metrics.

faq.question: Will it invent missing benchmarks?
faq.answer: No. Missing conversion rates, CPMs, or list counts are marked as needing a source.

faq.question: Does it check compliance concerns?
faq.answer: It flags sponsorship disclosure, offer claim support, and consent gaps for review before execution.
